title: Simply supported beam reactions and moments
prompt: Implement solve(payload) for a simply supported beam of length_m > 0, with loads [{"x_m":position,"force_n":force},...] and probes_m. Loads are signed: positive force_n acts downward; negative acts upward. Supports are at x=0 and x=length_m. Return {"left_reaction_n":R0,"right_reaction_n":RL,"moments_nm":[M(x),...]} with upward reactions positive and sagging bending moment positive. Use RL=sum(F*x)/L, R0=sum(F)-RL, and M(x)=R0*x-sum(F*max(0,x-load_x)); include loads applied at supports. Return {"error":"invalid_geometry"} if L<=0 or any load/probe is outside [0,L], before computing reactions. Empty loads/probes are valid. All numbers are finite and object fields are present. Do not mutate inputs. Absolute/relative tolerance 1e-8.
